summary_paragraph: Mr. Johnson, a patient with a history of cholangiocarcinoma and biliary stents, was admitted with fever, nausea, and vomiting. Workup revealed multifocal cholangitis and partial stent obstruction on MRCP. He was started on IV meropenem for suspected biliary infection. During ERCP to clear the stent, he developed hemobilia which resolved spontaneously without intervention. He remained hemodynamically stable, afebrile, and improved clinically. His pancytopenia remained stable throughout. He completed a 7-day course of antibiotics and was discharged home in stable condition with follow-up planned with gastroenterology and oncology.
